verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine. User-configured autonomous background automations, such as scheduled or recurring agent jobs, fall outside this product category, so the story is the wrong axis. Nothing in the evidence shows vLLM ships such a feature. Tool calling, structured outputs and the API server are building blocks that other systems could use to build automations, not automations offered by vLLM itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
